vanta.com verified. San Francisco security compliance / trust management platform (CEO Christina Cacioppo, founded 2018, YC). Series A $50M (Sequoia, May 2021, ~$500M valuation), Series B $110M (Craft Ventures, June 2022, $1.6B), Series C $150M (Sequoia, July 2024, $2.45B), Series D $150M (Wellington, July 23, 2025, $4.15B). Total $504M per Reuters (Reuters page paywalled; figure taken from search summary of the Reuters article); the four listed rounds sum to $460M, the remainder presumably earlier seed money not itemized here. Investor lists for B/C abbreviated.
